text: {"bull":["Operating profit rose 30.4% YoY to over ₹44 billion in Q4 FY26, the highest ever, reflecting strong sales and cost control.","Domestic sales volume grew 12.3% in H2 FY26, a swing of 17.9% from the first half, driven by the 18% GST bracket and strong demand for small cars.","Exports volume grew strongly in FY26, with Maruti Suzuki contributing 49% of India’s total passenger vehicle exports, underscoring its global market leadership.","The company added 0.5 million annual production capacity in FY26, a rare scale in the industry, positioning it to meet pending orders and capture growth.","bear",":",["Net profit fell 6.9% YoY to ₹36 billion in Q4 FY26, mainly due to mark‑to‑market impact, indicating pricing or valuation pressures.","Operating profit margin dropped to 8% in Q2 FY26 from 12% in earlier quarters, signalling cost pressures or margin compression.","Quarterly operating profit fell to ₹4,313 cr in Q2 FY26 from ₹6,158 cr in Q1 FY26, showing a sharp decline in profitability.","Net profit declined to ₹3,447 cr in Q2 FY26 from ₹3,659 cr in Q1 FY26, reflecting ongoing profitability challenges."]]}
